hero.title: Triaxial tilt sensor. High precision. ±0.01° accuracy.
hero.description: H310-TS380C is a high-precision triaxial tilt sensor with ±0.01° accuracy for local inclination monitoring on rack uprights, structural members, poles and equipment frames. Three-axis sensing, one-minute acquisition and four-hour scheduled reporting help connect a defined mounting point with a consistent history of change.

overview.title: Measure the angle. Follow the trend.

faqHeading.title: Frequently asked questions.
faqHeading.intro: Practical answers for specifying, installing and integrating the H310-TS380C high precision triaxial tilt sensor.

faqs.question: What is the H310-TS380C triaxial tilt sensor?
paragraphs: H310-TS380C is a high precision MEMS tilt sensor with ±0.01° accuracy and X/Y/Z sensing. It measures inclination at a defined mounting point, using the angle outputs and reference orientation specified by the supplied protocol.

Typical projects include warehouse rack uprights, poles, structural members and machine frames. One-minute acquisition and four-hour scheduled reporting support remote angle records for the selected points.

faqs.question: When should I choose H310-TS380C instead of H310-TS350M?
paragraphs: Choose H310-TS380C when the project calls for the finer ±0.01° accuracy grade and the installation can support that measurement objective. H310-TS350M provides the ±0.1° triaxial alternative.
Selection also depends on range, resolution, temperature, fixing stability and test conditions. Accuracy is separate from the displayed increment and the threshold that triggers a project review.

faqs.question: How does a triaxial tilt sensor differ from a two-axis model?
paragraphs: The triaxial version uses X/Y/Z sensing. The supplied protocol defines how those sensing axes are converted into reported angle channels and how the reference orientation is represented.

Choose the sensor around the outputs your monitoring plan needs and the mounting orientation. Three sensing axes alone do not establish three independent orientation angles or a complete 3D motion measurement.

faqs.question: Does three-axis sensing measure yaw or compass heading?
paragraphs: Gravity-referenced inclination does not independently determine yaw, which is rotation about the gravity direction. X/Y/Z labels identify the sensing axes; they should not be interpreted as a compass heading measurement.
For an application that needs heading or another motion quantity, describe it explicitly so the required sensing architecture can be reviewed before selection.

faqs.question: How do I establish a reliable installation reference?
paragraphs: Attach the sensor rigidly to the member whose inclination is to be monitored. Record the device ID, asset location, bracket position, axis orientation and initial angle after fixing.

Keep that reference with later readings. Recommission the reference after moving the device, changing the bracket or altering the measured member. A baseline supports comparison; it does not improve the stated accuracy.

faqs.question: What does the illustrated angle change represent?
paragraphs: The example compares 0.03° at installation with 0.05° later, a +0.02° change in one reported inclination channel. It illustrates reference comparison, rather than a three-axis vector or a complete 3D orientation.

These example values do not define range, resolution, a minimum detectable change or a notification threshold. Set review conditions for the real mounting point and applicable measurement performance.

faqs.question: What are the acquisition and scheduled-reporting intervals?
paragraphs: The reference profile acquires readings every minute and sends scheduled reports every four hours. This corresponds to 240 acquisition cycles between scheduled reports and six report intervals per day.

Acquisition frequency and transmission frequency are different. Agree which samples or values a report contains, any local retention, and the supported event-reporting and notification behaviour for your configuration.

faqs.question: Under what conditions does the 10-year battery-life figure apply?
paragraphs: The datasheet gives a 10-year reference with one-minute acquisition, four-hour reporting, 25°C and normal signal conditions. The battery configuration is 19000 mAh with a 38000 mAh option.
Actual service life varies with enabled functions, event frequency and radio retries. Select the power arrangement against the installation conditions and operating profile.

faqs.question: Which enclosure and environmental limits apply?
paragraphs: The specified options are a metal IP68 enclosure or a plastic IP66 enclosure. Operating and storage temperature is −40°C to +85°C; operating humidity is 5% to 95% RH, non-condensing.

Select the enclosure, antenna and mounting kit for the actual exposure and access conditions. The 115 × 90 × 60 mm dimension is a platform body reference; verify the selected arrangement for installation drawings.

faqs.question: Can I choose 4G LTE, NB-IoT or LoRa?
paragraphs: The datasheet lists LTE Cat.1 (4G), with NB-IoT and LoRa by selected variant. Choose the configuration around the installation country, regional bands, operator or compatible receiver, and the required data route.
LoRa identifies the radio option; a LoRaWAN requirement needs explicit protocol compatibility confirmation. Confirm the supplied radio, gateway and platform combination before ordering.

faqs.question: Can the readings be sent to our existing platform?
paragraphs: Hitelecom Cloud or a compatible customer platform can be used with the supported data interface. Share your interface, authentication and asset-data requirements during the project review.

Agree a sample message that identifies the device, mounting point, channel names, axis convention, angle units, timestamps and reference. Test the complete path using the selected device configuration.

faqs.question: What are NFC and remote firmware updates used for?
paragraphs: NFC activation and local configuration support installation and commissioning. Record the final settings and installation reference before starting the monitoring programme.
Remote firmware updates are supported on selected versions. Confirm availability and the supplied device configuration, together with your platform and update workflow.

faqs.question: Can one triaxial model cover racks, structures, poles and machine frames?
paragraphs: H310-TS380C can be evaluated for each of these mounting-point applications where ±0.01° accuracy, the supplied angle outputs and installation conditions meet the monitoring plan. The Applications section covers tasks across nine sectors, with warehouse racking first.

For racks, identify uprights and fixing points; for infrastructure, define the monitored member with the responsible engineer. Machine-frame inclination is a static or settled-position task. Minute-interval tilt readings do not specify dynamic vibration, rapid motion or machinery alignment performance.

faqs.question: What information is needed for a quotation or OEM project?
paragraphs: Include H310-TS380C, the installation country, quantities, application and rollout date. Share a site photograph or drawing, mounting orientation, required per-axis range, useful angle change and expected environment.

Add the selected network, platform interface, reporting and event-response requirements, sample acceptance criteria and any OEM / white-label needs. CE is completed for the H200/H300/H500 platform; confirm certificate applicability and other requested compliance references for the supplied configuration.
